notes: Real-paper gold case from STUDY-c949b1b401bb, DOI 10.1093/ismejo/wrae013, PMCID PMC10942774. Curated from stored Europe PMC full-text evidence for the methane-flux coastal sediment study.
source_text: The extracted RNA was delivered to SciLifeLab, Stockholm where libraries were prepared with the TruSeq Stranded mRNA kit (Illumina) excluding the poly-A selection step, that is, libraries contained total RNA. The libraries were sequenced on a NovaSeq 6000 (Illumina) S4 lane with a 2 x 150 bp setup and the output data were demultiplexed by the sequencing facility.
